new_entities.name: OpenBankingConsent
new_entities.description: Represents a customer's grant of payment consent to a Third Party Provider (TPP/PISP) under the OBIE Domestic Payment Consents API (PSR 2017). Created by SVC-001 when SVC-017 (channel) calls POST /open-banking-consents synchronously. Tracks the full consent lifecycle from awaiting_auth through to terminal states (consumed, revoked, expired). This is the authoritative consent record — it binds a specific customer (customer_id) to a specific account (account_id) for a single payment to a specific payee. The consent_id is the OBIE ConsentId returned to the TPP. Once the consent is consumed (payment initiated), it cannot be reused. Owned by SVC-001 (CAP-001) because consent is a customer-account aggregate — not a channel-layer artefact.

fields.name: consent_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-001. Immutable after creation. Returned to TPP as the OB-ConsentId in the POST /domestic-payment-consents response. Must be globally unique.

fields.name: tpp_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → TPPRegistration.tpp_id (ENT-031). The software_statement_id from the TPP's OBIE-signed SSA. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Set at PH-037 after the customer authenticates and links the consent to their identity. Immutable once set.
fields.transparency_note: Linked to the customer at SCA completion. The customer has given explicit dynamic-linked consent binding them to this specific payment. UK GDPR Article 6(1)(b) — contract performance; PSR 2017 Reg. 68 consent obligations.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id (ENT-004). The debtor account the customer selected during PH-037 consent confirmation. Immutable once set.

fields.name: consent_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: single_payment | recurring. For JRN-010 (PISP single payment), always single_payment. recurring reserved for VRP flows (JRN-029).

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal. Max 2 decimal places. GBP only. Min: 0.01. Max: 250000.00 (FPS per-transaction limit). Immutable — the payment amount is locked at consent creation; any mismatch at PH-038 must result in rejection.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217. For domestic FPS payments: always GBP. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit UK sort code (no hyphens). Validated against Vocalink EISCD. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit UK account number. Validated against Vocalink EISCD modulus check rules. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. TPP-provided payee name. Max 140 characters. Displayed to customer at PH-037 for explicit confirmation. Used as CoP input. Immutable.
fields.transparency_note: Displayed verbatim to the customer during the SCA consent screen at PH-037 to satisfy dynamic-linking requirements under PSD2 RTS on SCA. CoP result also shown at consent confirmation.

fields.name: payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Max 35 characters (OBIE EndToEndIdentification limit). Alphanumeric and limited special characters per FPS scheme rules. Immutable.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: awaiting_auth | authorised | consumed | revoked | expired. State machine: awaiting_auth → authorised (PH-037 SCA success) → consumed (PH-038 payment initiated). awaiting_auth → revoked (customer declines at PH-037). awaiting_auth → expired (SCA timeout or consent TTL exceeded). authorised → expired (TPP does not initiate within 90 minutes). Terminal states: consumed | revoked | expired.

fields.name: sca_completed
fields.validation_rule: Required. Defaults to false at creation. Set to true atomically with status transition to authorised at PH-037. Immutable once true. Must be true before payment initiation at PH-038 is permitted.
fields.transparency_note: Audit evidence that PSR 2017 SCA requirements were met before payment initiation.

fields.name: sca_method
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when sca_completed = true. Enum: biometric_mobile | sms_otp | hardware_otp. Reflects the SCA method used. Immutable once set.

fields.name: open_banking_payment_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → PaymentIntent.payment_intent_id (ENT-008). Set atomically with status = consumed at PH-038. Null until payment is initiated.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: authorised_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status transitions to authorised. Immutable once set.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Set at creation: awaiting_auth consents expire after 24 hours. After authorisation, expires 90 minutes from authorised_at (OBIE standard). System enforces expiry by transitioning status = expired on TTL breach.

fields.name: consumed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status transitions to consumed at PH-038. Immutable once set.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status transitions to revoked (customer declines) or when customer revokes via consent dashboard. Immutable once set.

fields.name: cop_result
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when CoP check is executed at PH-036/PH-037. Enum: match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist. Stored for audit purposes. Immutable once set.
fields.transparency_note: CoP result displayed to the customer on the consent confirmation screen at PH-037. Retained in audit trail for APP fraud gross negligence assessment (PSR PS23/3).

relationships.description: OpenBankingConsent belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK. Set at PH-037 after SCA.
OpenBankingConsent is linked to one Account (the debtor account) via account_id FK.
OpenBankingConsent is associated with one TPPRegistration via tpp_id FK.
A consumed OpenBankingConsent has exactly one PaymentIntent (ENT-008) linked via open_banking_payment_id FK. Null until PH-038 payment initiation.

design_decisions.decision: ENT-030 is owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core), not by SVC-017 (Digital Channels channel service).
design_decisions.rationale: Consent is a PSR 2017-regulated customer-account agreement. It must persist in the core banking domain alongside Customer (ENT-001) and Account (ENT-004). SVC-017 is a channel layer with no persistent domain state ownership. Placing consent in the channel layer would expose a legally significant record to replatforming risk.

design_decisions.decision: The amount, payee details, and currency are immutable on ENT-030 after creation. Any mismatch at payment initiation (PH-038) results in consent rejection.
design_decisions.rationale: PSD2 RTS on SCA Regulation 97 dynamic linking requires that the SCA is bound to the specific amount and payee to which the customer consented. Mutating these fields after SCA would break the dynamic linking guarantee and constitute a PSR 2017 breach.

new_entities.name: TPPRegistration
new_entities.description: Represents a Third Party Provider's registration with the bank under Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) per the OBIE DCR specification. Created when a TPP completes DCR at PH-035 by presenting a valid OBIE Software Statement Assertion (SSA). Stores the TPP's identity, FCA authorisation reference, registered redirect URIs, and registration status. This record is the bank's authoritative lookup for validating TPP credentials on every API call. Owned by SVC-001 (CAP-001) as a customer-facing regulatory record.

fields.name: tpp_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. The OBIE-issued organisation_id from the TPP's SSA (OB Directory OrganisationId). Used as the primary key. Immutable after creation. Matches the client_id issued by the bank's DCR endpoint.

fields.name: tpp_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. The TPP's registered trading name from the OBIE Directory. Max 200 characters. Updated if the TPP re-registers with a new SSA.

fields.name: obie_org_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. The OBIE Organisation ID from the SSA. Used to validate the TPP against the OBIE Directory at runtime. Immutable.

fields.name: fca_reference_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. The TPP's FCA Firm Reference Number (FRN). Must be validated against the FCA Register at registration time. Format: 6–9 digits. Immutable.
fields.transparency_note: Validated against FCA FS Register to confirm the TPP holds a current PISP authorisation. Stored as evidence of regulatory validation.

fields.name: software_statement_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. The OBIE-issued Software Statement ID from the SSA (OB Directory SoftwareStatementId). Immutable after creation. Used to validate SSA signatures on each API call.

fields.name: redirect_uris
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array of 1–5 HTTPS redirect URIs registered by the TPP during DCR. Must exactly match the redirect_uris in the SSA. Mutable via re-registration (new SSA required). Each URI max 2048 characters. No HTTP URIs permitted.

fields.name: permitted_scopes
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array of OAuth 2.0 scopes granted to this TPP. For PISP: ['payments', 'openid']. For AISP: ['accounts', 'openid']. For combined: both. Constrained by the TPP's FCA authorisation type.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | suspended | revoked. Defaults to active on registration. Bank may set suspended or revoked if the TPP's FCA authorisation is withdrawn, the OBIE SSA is revoked, or the bank exercises its right under PSR 2017 to block a specific TPP for documented fraud or security reasons.

fields.name: registered_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: last_validated_at
fields.validation_rule: Updated each time the bank validates the TPP's FCA registration status against the FCA FS Register. Bank must revalidate at least every 24 hours. ISO 8601 UTC.

fields.name: client_secret_hash
fields.validation_rule: Required. Bcrypt hash of the client_secret issued at DCR. The plaintext client_secret is never stored. The hash is used to validate client credentials on token endpoint calls.
fields.transparency_note: Stored as a one-way hash only. Plaintext never persisted post-issuance.

relationships.description: A TPPRegistration may be associated with many OpenBankingConsents (one per customer payment consent request). Linked via ENT-030.tpp_id.

design_decisions.decision: ENT-031 is owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core), co-located with ENT-030.
design_decisions.rationale: TPP registration is a bank-level regulatory record under PSR 2017. It must be accessible to the consent management and payment initiation logic in SVC-001 without a cross-service call. Co-location with ENT-030 ensures atomic validation of TPP status before consent creation.

design_decisions.decision: client_secret is stored as a bcrypt hash only. The plaintext is delivered once at DCR and never stored.
design_decisions.rationale: Standard OAuth 2.0 client credential security practice. The client_secret is a shared secret analogous to a password — it must be treated with equivalent storage security. A breach of the TPPRegistration table must not expose usable client credentials.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Customer
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: customer_id linked to ENT-030 at PH-037 after SCA. SVC-001 validates customer status (active) before creating the consent link.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Account
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: account_id linked to ENT-030 at PH-037 (debtor account selection). SVC-001 validates account status (active) and available balance at PH-038.

referenced_existing_entities.name: PaymentIntent
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: Created by SVC-001 at PH-038 when the TPP initiates the payment. Linked to ENT-030 via open_banking_payment_id. Carries the full payment lifecycle through PH-039 execution.

referenced_existing_entities.name: PaymentExecution
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: Created by SVC-009 at PH-039 when FPS submission is initiated. Holds the FPS fps_reference, pacs.008 message reference, and settlement status.

entity_extensions.description: JRN-010 adds open-banking-specific fields to PaymentIntent (ENT-008) to enable OB consent cross-reference and status mapping.

new_fields.name: consent_id
new_fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → OpenBankingConsent.consent_id (ENT-030). Required for all payments initiated via the Open Banking channel (origination_channel = open_banking). Null for payments initiated directly (JRN-002). Immutable after creation.

new_fields.name: origination_channel
new_fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: direct | open_banking. direct = standard customer-initiated payment (JRN-002). open_banking = PISP-initiated via OB consent (JRN-010). Immutable after creation.

new_fields.name: tpp_id
new_fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when origination_channel = open_banking. FK → TPPRegistration.tpp_id (ENT-031). Denormalised for audit query efficiency. Immutable.
